name: Holon-Energie WP
effect:
Holon Energy WP provides  Energy.
If the Pokémon that Holon Energy WP is attached to also has any basic  Energy card attached to it, prevent all effects, excluding damage, done to that Pokémon by your opponent's Pokémon. If the Pokémon that Holon Energy WP is attached to also has any basic  Energy card attached to it, that Pokémon's Retreat Cost is 0. Ignore these effects if Holon Energy WP is attached to Pokémon-ex.
author: Takumi Akabane
